description: Header file defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes for WAN manager web configuration in a network device, including structures for interface, marking, and failover configurations.

methods.name: WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_Wanmanager_Params
methods.description: Processes WAN manager parameters from msgpack object into WebConfig structure.

methods.name: WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_ifParams
methods.description: Processes interface parameters from msgpack object into interface table structure.

methods.name: WaneMgr_WebConfig_Process_MarkingEntry
methods.description: Processes a marking entry from msgpack object into marking table structure.

methods.name: WanMgr_WebConfig_Process_WanFailOver_Params
methods.description: Processes WAN failover parameters from msgpack object into WebConfig structure.
